advisory_en: TEKHAND: flood probability 57% — risk level WATCH. Flagged at this risk level since 05:30 IST. Highest probability so far at 16:30 IST. About 119,953 residents are in the exposed area, with 1 hospital(s), 1 school(s) and 68.3 km of road. Main drivers: rainfall today, near an underpass, dense built-up. 1 pump(s) are mapped in this ward.
